newsitem.title: UK: MOTOR RACING-F1 CHAMPION HILL WINS BBC PERSONALITY OF YEAR AWARD.
newsitem.headline: MOTOR RACING-F1 CHAMPION HILL WINS BBC PERSONALITY OF YEAR AWARD.

text.p: Motor racing world champion Damon Hill was named BBC Sports Personality of the Year on Sunday.
"I feel immensely proud to take this award. It's made my year for me," said the British driver who also won the coveted television award two years ago.
Rower Steve Redgrave, second to Hill, won the Team of the Year award with coxless pairs partner Matthew Pinsent. They won Britain's only gold medal at the Atlanta Olympics.
